real_qa.r: Being on Pinterest and having it work for you are not the same thing. real_qa.q: What are the key diagnostic questions to determine if your Pinterest strategy is working?
real_qa.r: Four critical questions to assess your Pinterest effectiveness: Do you know what happens after someone finds your pin, or are you just hoping they'll click and buy?
